findings.evidence: Fold builders slice train before validation and preserve order.
target.py uses the next available observation; phase 4 uses shift(-horizon).
Phase 3 Ridge mean/std are computed from X_train only; no scaler or imputer fit on full data was found in inspected research files.
Rolling and pct_change features are backward-looking; phase 6 regime thresholds use training signals.
Feature audit marks close-derived features unavailable at open; Phase 4 results mark unavailable OHLC targets where source fields are absent.
Phase 2-6 fold starts add the configured embargo and training ends before validation.
Model and baseline arrays are formed from the same validation rows; Phase 2-4 aggregate experiments remain separate populations.
Phase 6 interval history is extended only after each validation fold.
No formal Ljung-Box dependency was installed; this remediation reports transparent ACF instead.
